product.name: Monoprice Professional Networking Tool Kit
product.description: Make your own professional quality Ethernet and other network cables to the exact lengths you require using this Professional Networking Kit from Monoprice™!This kit contains everything you need to make Ethernet cables, except for the cable itself. It includes six 8P8C RJ45 and six 6P6C RJ12 plugs, a crimping tool designed to fit both plug types, a punch‑down tool for 110 type terminal blocks, and a UTP/STP flat cable stripper/cutter.A cable tester is also included to ensure that your finished cables are fully operational.Package Contents: 1x Crimp tool for 6P/8P plugs1x Punch‑down tool for 110 type terminal blocks1x UTP/STP, flat cable stripper/cutter1x Cable cutter6x 8P8C plugs6x 6P6C plugsCable tester for RJ45 (EIA/TIA 568A/568B), 10BaseT, Token Ring, RJ11/12 USOC, and Coaxial BNC cablesSupport Files: User's Manual (Jul 8, 2011)Line Drawing (May 27, 2025)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
